# RealWorld Backend — TypeScript / Fastify / Prisma / SQLite

An implementation of the [RealWorld backend specification](https://realworld-docs.netlify.app/specifications/backend/endpoints/).

**Status: all 154 requests across the 13 official Hurl test files pass.**

## Requirements

- Node.js 20+
- [Hurl](https://hurl.dev/) (only to run the API test suite)

## Quick start

```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```

`npm run dev` generates the Prisma client, creates/syncs the SQLite database, and
starts the server on <http://localhost:8000>. No other setup step is required —
the database file is created on first run.

## Running the API tests

With the server running in another terminal:

```bash
npm run test:api
```

This runs the vendored official suite in `api/hurl/` against
`http://localhost:8000`. Override the target with `HOST=... npm run test:api`,
or pass specific files:

```bash
./api/run-api-tests-hurl.sh api/hurl/articles.hurl
```

Expected output:

```
Executed files:    13
Executed requests: 154
Succeeded files:   13 (100.0%)
Failed files:      0 (0.0%)
```

## Scripts

| Script | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `npm run dev` | Sync the database, then start with file watching |
| `npm start` | Sync the database, then start once |
| `npm run db:setup` | `prisma generate` + `prisma db push` |
| `npm run typecheck` | Type-check without emitting |
| `npm run test:api` | Run the vendored Hurl suite |

## Configuration

Settings come from `.env` (see `.env.example`):

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DATABASE_URL` | `file:./dev.db` | SQLite location |
| `JWT_SECRET` | `realworld-dev-secret` | Token signing key |
| `PORT` | `8000` | Listen port |

## Project layout
